podcast.title: Career Launched by Ted Mack Amateur Hour
podcast.body: Gladys Knight's career was successfully launched by her appearance on the Ted Mack Amateur Hour, a popular 1950s TV talent show. "The show launched the careers of Pat Boone and Margaret in Gladys Knight among others."

xref.title: Musical Family Background
xref.body: Thundercat, whose real name is Stephen Lee Bruner, hails from a highly musical family. His father was a professional drummer who played for iconic Motown acts such as The Supremes, Gladys Knight, and The Temptations, while his mother was a professional musician who played the flute and percussion. "Thundercat comes from a very musical family. His dad played drums for the Supremes and Gladys Knight and the Temptations and other Motown acts. His mother was also a professional musician, playing the flute in percussion."
